messages.author: 17d9c7a6e1a581b8
messages.subject: State of PyStan on Windows
parts:
Hi everyone,

If you're interested in using PyStan for Windows your best bet is to use
Anaconda Python 2.7 and use the precompiled version of PyStan (2.4.0.3,
I believe). We're working on a new release.

Here are the steps to install PyStan on Windows:

- Install Anaconda Python 2.7
- Install and configure Visual Studio 2008 Express, using these instructions: https://github.com/menpo/menpo/wiki/%5BDevelopment-Windows%5D-Setting-up-a-development-environment
- Install PyStan via conda: conda install -c patricksnape pystan

That's it! PyStan should work at this point.

If you've found another reproducible way to install and use PyStan on Windows,
please get in touch (preferably via stan...@googlegroups.com). It would be
great to hear about your experience.

Thanks,

Allen
